title: Calendar
label: Label
separateHint: Turn on to drag one account’s post at a time. You can also reschedule from its preview.
emptyBody: No posts in this period. Choose a day to start writing, or change your filters.
stale: The calendar couldn’t refresh. These are the last posts we loaded.
truncated: This period has more than 1,000 deliveries. Some posts are hidden; switch to Week or narrow your filters.
filterError: Some filters couldn’t load. Try refreshing the calendar.
deleteBody: This removes the whole post and its waiting deliveries from the calendar.
notFound: This post is no longer available.

errors.tooSoon: Choose a time at least 2 minutes from now.
errors.tooFar: Choose a time within the next year.
errors.changed: Someone moved this delivery while you were viewing it. The calendar now shows their time. Open its preview to choose another time.
errors.notScheduled: This delivery is no longer scheduled. The calendar has been refreshed.
errors.review: This post needs approval before it can be scheduled.
errors.validation: This post needs changes. Open the composer to review its validation issues.
errors.gone: This delivery was removed. The calendar has been refreshed.
